eps.o: When Plankton takes over the North Pole, SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs, and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas.
When SpongeBob loses his imagination, he tries desperately to get it back.
When Mr. Krabs begrudgingly becomes the caretaker for Pearl's new pet worm, the two form an unexpected bond.
All the residents of Bikini Bottom get interviewed for a TV show.
Patrick opens his first bank account, but then gets caught up in something bigger.
